body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one ally within 5 units. Until your next turn, the first time it becomes eligible to make a Reaction, it may commit 1 fewer die, minimum 2.

surges.html: A second ally may receive one non-damage benefit of this card.
One affected ally may ignore the next die it would burn before your next turn.

rider.title: SIGNAL — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when initiative priority reaches an ally: 1–3 that ally gains +1 Defense; 4–5 it becomes Rallied; 6+ it becomes Rallied and may shift 1 unit.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
